variants.prompt: Ava lounges on a plush, velvety chaise in a dimly lit boudoir, the antique furniture and heavy drapes casting long shadows across her provocatively posed body. She wears a sheer, crimson lace negligee that clings to her every contour, leaving little to the imagination. Her long, raven hair tumbles down her back as she looks over her shoulder with a coy, half-lidded gaze, one hand trailing down her thigh to the edge of her garter belt.
